def hidden_rule_fn(state):
    # A-strand: even-indexed elements
    # B-strand: odd-indexed elements
    # The next state appends one element computed as:
    #   If appending to even position (A-strand): (last_A + last_B) % 8
    #   If appending to odd position (B-strand): (last_A ^ last_B ^ len_A) % 8
    
    A = [state[i] for i in range(0, len(state), 2)]
    B = [state[i] for i in range(1, len(state), 2)]
    
    last_A = A[-1] if A else 0
    last_B = B[-1] if B else 0
    len_A = len(A)
    
    new_pos = len(state)  # position of the new element
    
    if new_pos % 2 == 0:
        # Appending to A-strand
        new_value = (last_A + last_B) % 8
    else:
        # Appending to B-strand
        new_value = (last_A ^ last_B ^ len_A) % 8
    
    return state + [new_value]
